message.content: {"flag": true, "category": "spoof", "why": "The page presents itself as Intel investor-relations material but is hosted on a look-alike domain (intc-ir-update.com) rather than intel.com, an unofficial 'analyst desk note' impersonating official filings."}
message.reasoning:
The URL is a look-alike domain: intc-ir-update.com, not intel.com. Title says "analyst desk note" with "adjusted operating income reconciliation". Figures: Intel FY2023 net revenue $54.2B, net income $1.7B — those are roughly correct. But the domain is a look-alike, spoof. Also "adjusted operating income" — Intel GAAP operating income 2023 was $93M... actually Intel 2023 GAAP operating income was $93 million? Intel 2023: revenue 54.2B, operating income 93M, net income 1.7B. Yes those are correct. But the domain is suspicious — look-alike domain. Flag spoof.

Hmm, but is it just a recap site? The domain "intc-ir-update.com" mimics investor relations. That's a look-alike domain. Flag spoof.
